description: For anyone about to send or swap: live fee estimate in USD for an ETH transfer, ERC-20 transfer or DEX swap on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism (L2 execution + L1 data fee), the cheapest chain right now, and how current Ethereum fees compare with the last ~7 hours. Input: optional tx_type and chains, e.g. {"tx_type":"dex_swap"}. Output: ranking, per-chain gwei and USD, timing read. Seconds. Limits: estimates from public RPCs, typical gas units, no guarantee of future fees. Not financial advice.
